correctness.rationale: Explicit trace and determinant calculations imply chi_B(rA)=(F-f)(S-s)(K-rA). If R2>R1, K falls strictly from infinity to R2 and rA rises strictly from a finite value to infinity, proving exactly one crossing. Exact rational witness matrices have determinant signs -59/800 and +23/1600 at one with all diagonals <1, hence aligned growth and opposite-phase decline. value.rationale: The standard zero-juvenile-stasis model exhibits anti-phase preference; proving the exact boundary for positive juvenile stasis and heterogeneous seasonal adult retention identifies a structural mechanism and rigorously characterizes a unique policy reversal. The exact admissible witness demonstrates crossing of the population growth threshold by phase scheduling alone, making the outcome materially meaningful for stage-structured seasonality rather than routine parameter substitution. Scope is only linear deterministic two-stage, two-season projection.
